title: thoa buchholziana
intro: Thoa buchholziana, commonly known as the Red Stinkwood or Buchholz's Thoa, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae, native to Madagascar and used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Thoa buchholziana include its potential to treat various ailments, such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as limonoids, alkaloids, and flavonoids. These bioactive constituents are also believed to contribute to the plant's potential in treating various diseases, including cancer, due to their antioxidant and cytotoxic properties.
